title: Samay Raina Brings an Exclusive Episode of 'India's Got Latent' Season 2 to Netflix with Varun Dhawan as Special Guest!
summary: Samay Raina is bringing an exclusive episode of India's Got Latent Season 2 to Netflix with Varun Dhawan as a special guest on the 4th of September!
body_markdown:
Entertainment


02 September 2026


Global


India


Link copied to clipboard


If you've laughed until your sides hurt, questioned humanity, and somehow still come back for more, here's your reward — Samay Raina is bringing an exclusive episode of


India's Got Latent


Season 2


to Netflix with


Varun Dhawan


as a special guest on September 4!


Known for its unfiltered humour, unpredictable talent, outrageous one-liners and moments that take over the internet within minutes, India's Got Latent has become one of India's most talked-about comedy shows. Now, for one special episode, the madness gets even bigger with Varun Dhawan joining the fun, alongside an exciting lineup of special guests, in an exclusive that will stream only on Netflix.


Expect everything audiences love about


Latent


— unexpected performances, relentless banter, spontaneous chaos and the kind of comedy that refuses to stay inside the episode long after it's over. And with Varun Dhawan in the mix, expect a few moments that may leave the internet smiling…


slightly sideways


.


Varun Dhawan said,


"Comedy is a genre I love performing and enjoy watching as well. Samay's brand of comedy is so unpredictable that I wanted to experience it live. I had a great time and hopefully everyone on Netflix enjoys this special as much as I did."


The exclusive episode of


India's Got Latent


Season 2 will stream only on Netflix.
